propositions: Core reconciler transport parameters were untyped or typed as Any, preventing mypy from enforcing port contract completeness and allowing backends to silently omit required methods.
Annotations with port types imported via rebar_reconciler.* path resolve to Any under mypy due to ignore_missing_imports, producing no static enforcement while appearing correct in review.

Relative imports from ._backend within reconciler modules restore mypy's ability to resolve TicketTransport and enforce attribute checking, while the existing _TransportPortMeta metaclass does not prevent this enforcement.

Four opt-in capability members (add_comment, set_relationship, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) are carried as metaclass attributes so hasattr returns True while mypy correctly reports them missing, requiring narrowing to composed capability Protocols at call sites rather than adding to the port body.

A test guard must reject bare parameters, Any-annotated parameters, and parameters annotated through the unresolvable rebar_reconciler.* import path to prevent future changes from silently reintroducing blindness.
